decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with its own page and an explicit announced release timeline, management is likely to stay committed and treat any slow uptake or regulatory limits as temporary rather than abandon it quickly.
Because the firm has already invested in development and publicly presented this new chamber as a stand-alone product, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
This product is too new and too visibly launched for management to reverse course quickly, especially in a specialized German technical niche where early commercialization often takes time.
A standard clinical ionization chamber fits closely with the firm's core dosimetry business, so prior investment and strategic fit both support continued commitment.
Given its dedicated market presentation and close relation to the firm's established measurement portfolio, management would be inclined to justify and continue the launch rather than exit early.
Even if initial demand were modest, the sunk development effort and public introduction of this thimble chamber would push management toward persistence over rapid withdrawal.
